baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated q-r-hamza expression surrounds the imperative from t-b-ayn, while the when-then construction places the first act before the response.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reading or teaching a recitation supplies the leading act, and ordinary following supplies the recipient's subsequent recitation or compliance. The source therefore leads and the addressee responds after it.

activation_trace.role: Reading, reciting, and teaching recitation provide the utterance that leads the exchange.
Following after a person, command, or trace makes the imperative a response to the prior utterance.

changed_reading.before: A generic command to repeat a recitation.
changed_reading.after: Once the divine recitation is delivered, the addressee is to come after it in recitation and compliance, preserving source-before-response order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same q-r-hamza root occurs as both the completed divine act and the object to be followed, with the following imperative between them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gathering branch turns the recited object into an assembled whole, while stepwise tracking and ordered succession turn following into preservation of that whole's sequence rather than free repetition.

activation_trace.role: Collecting and joining supply an assembled object whose parts belong together.
Tracking one trace after another makes the response proceed through the assembled object step by step.
Consecutive succession supplies fidelity to the object's internal order.

changed_reading.before: Follow the sound of a recitation.
changed_reading.after: Follow the recitation as an assembled sequence, tracking its parts in their given order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessed q-r-hamza noun is the direct object of following and can therefore name not only an utterance but the manner it sets.
baseline_models.mechanism: A patterned or directed course combines with following and internal consistency: the command asks the recipient to conform to the recitation's model, not merely echo its sounds.

activation_trace.role: A manner, exemplar, or directed course lets the recitation function as a pattern to be taken up.
Mastery and internal consistency make following a faithful, coherent realization of the pattern.

changed_reading.after: Take up the recitation's manner and directed course, reproducing its coherence in the response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional when-clause explicitly marks an arrival point, and the following imperative begins only after that threshold.
baseline_models.mechanism: The appointed-time branch of q-r-hamza and the catching-up branch of t-b-ayn yield a temporal model: wait for the due arrival, then come after what has gone ahead.

activation_trace.role: An appointed time arriving or being delayed gives the first clause a due threshold.
Catching up with one who has gone ahead makes the imperative deliberately posterior.

changed_reading.before: Follow while the recitation is occurring.
changed_reading.after: When its proper moment arrives and it has gone ahead, catch up to it rather than anticipating it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative uses t-b-ayn directly upon the possessed recitation, allowing the object to impose more than acoustic imitation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A recited communication can present a claim; the pursuit-of-right and attached-liability branches make following the act of accepting and answering what that communication lays upon its recipient.

activation_trace.role: The recited communication supplies the claim-bearing object.
Pursuit of a right turns following into answering a demand carried by the recitation.
An incurred consequence or liability supplies what attaches to the recipient after hearing.

changed_reading.before: Follow the recitation as verbal form.
changed_reading.after: Follow it by accepting and answering the claim and consequence that its recitation attaches to the hearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding promise explicitly joins divine gathering with recitation. That pairing selects the focus root's collecting branch and makes the command a demand to track a completed, assembled delivery in its supplied order.

activation_trace.role: The focus root's collecting image supplies an assembled recitation on both sides of the imperative.
Stepwise tracking specifies how the assembled delivery is to be followed.
Joining dispersed parts into one whole makes collection an explicit operation immediately before the command.
The context occurrence places the recitation itself in the same gathering field.

structural_cues: 75:17 places gathering and recitation under the same first-person responsibility immediately before 75:18 repeats q-r-hamza around the imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit gathering beside recitation and a repeated focus root; I infer that the followed object is a divinely assembled sequence, while ordinary auditory recitation without a collection metaphor remains live.

changed_reading.after: Track the divinely collected recitation as a complete ordered whole whose sequence is not supplied by the recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prohibition on moving the tongue to hurry blocks premature bodily production. The focus when-then sequence and the catching-up branch then recast following as intentional lag: receive the leading recitation first and only afterward reproduce or comply with it.

activation_trace.role: Recitation and teaching provide the leading speech that must first be received.
Catching up supplies a follower who moves only after the leader has gone ahead.
Bodily movement opposed to stillness identifies the premature response that is stopped.
The speech organ locates the blocked anticipation in vocal production.
Speeding and bringing forward name the temporal error that following corrects.

structural_cues: The negative command in 75:16, the divine responsibilities in 75:17, and the when-then command in 75:18 form a stop-wait-follow sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tongue movement, haste, a divine leading act, and subsequent following; I infer a required receptive lag, while simultaneous subvocal memorization remains a possible narrower target of the prohibition.

changed_reading.after: Do not race the source with the tongue; let the recitation lead, then catch up in faithful response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine collection and recitation precede the recipient's following, and divine disclosure follows it. The imperative therefore occupies a distinct receptive stage: preserve and track what is delivered before attempting to supply its clarification independently.

activation_trace.role: The recited communication is the material received in the middle stage.
Stepwise tracking defines the recipient's task between delivery and disclosure.
Completion without dispersion supplies a finished divine collection before the recipient acts.
The preceding recitation is explicitly assigned to the divine side of the exchange.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies a later explanatory stage.

structural_cues: 75:17 and 75:19 repeat the same first-person responsibility construction on either side of the recipient's imperative in 75:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine collection/recitation, human following, then divine explanation; I infer a division of roles and epistemic sequence, while explanation could instead be an immediate continuation that does not restrict interpretive activity.

changed_reading.before: Follow because the recitation is already self-explained.
changed_reading.after: Receive and preserve the delivered sequence first; explanation remains a subsequent divine act rather than something the hurried recipient must manufacture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate rebuke of loving what is brought forward and abandoning what comes later generalizes the local haste problem. Following the recitation becomes training in ordered delay: the recipient lets the due sequence govern desire rather than seizing the immediate term.

activation_trace.role: The image of a due time arriving makes recitation subject to an appointed sequence.
Orderly succession gives the response a later, non-anticipatory place.
Laterness after a first term supplies the deferred horizon that must not be abandoned.
Bringing something forward turns haste into a wider preference for immediacy.
Heart-attached love supplies the desire that pulls the recipient ahead of the given order.
Leaving something behind names the rejected alternative to sustained following.

structural_cues: The abrupt rebuke in 75:20-21 follows immediately after the collection-following-explanation sequence and repeats its contrast between haste and later order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies local haste followed by love of immediacy and abandonment of the later; I infer that the speech instruction instantiates a broader temporal ethic, while the plural rebuke may address a wider audience rather than gloss the imperative directly.

changed_reading.before: A narrow technique for accurate vocal repetition.
changed_reading.after: A discipline of letting revelation's due order lead desire, resisting the urge to possess the immediate and discard what follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later negative portrait pairs failure to confirm and worship with denial and turning away. Against that contrast, following the recitation expands from vocal tracking into truthful assent and embodied response.

activation_trace.role: The recited message supplies what is either received or denied.
Mastery and consistency make following a response whose conduct coheres with what was heard.
Making a promise or claim true in action supplies enacted confirmation.
Specific worship supplies a bodily realization of assent rather than a merely verbal echo.
Attributing falsehood provides the explicit opposite of receiving the recited message as true.
Turning away supplies the directional opposite of following after.

structural_cues: 75:31-32 forms a paired contrast: no confirmation and no worship, but denial and turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later contrast between confirmation/worship and denial/turning; I infer that it displays the behavioral stakes of following, while those verses may describe general rejection rather than directly define the focus command.

changed_reading.before: Follow by accurately repeating the recited wording.
changed_reading.after: Follow by making the received recitation true in assent and worship rather than denying it and turning away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding report itemizes what a person advanced and deferred, meets inward self-sight, and survives offered excuses. This activates the focus following root's claim and liability branches: the recitation is a report whose disclosed consequences attach to its hearer and must be answered.

activation_trace.role: The recited communication provides the report that reaches the accountable hearer.
Pursuing a right lets the delivered report press a claim upon its recipient.
Attached liability turns following into acceptance of the report's entailments.
Inner sight supplies a witness within the person that recognizes the disclosed account.
A report arriving and being conveyed supplies the formal disclosure.
Advancing ahead supplies one temporal class of deeds in the account.
Deferring to a later time supplies the complementary class that remains reportable.
Excuse and apology supply the attempted defense that does not erase the account.

structural_cues: 75:13-15 presents report, self-witness, and excuses immediately before the reception instructions of 75:16-19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a delivered itemized account, inward recognition, and excuses; I infer that its claim attaches to the hearer through the focus root's liability image, while the nearer referent of the focus remains revelation rather than the eschatological account itself.

changed_reading.before: Repeat a communication without specifying its demand on the hearer.
changed_reading.after: Receive the recitation as a claim-bearing disclosure and follow through on the consequences it makes answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah frames the speech unit with divine gathering of bodily parts and exact creation and proportioning. That material sequence makes the adjacent gathering of recitation look like a homologous reconstitution: dispersed elements become a complete ordered whole, which the recipient must preserve by consistent succession.

activation_trace.role: Collection and joining anchor the focus recitation as an assembled whole.
Succession in order is the recipient's means of preserving the assembled whole.
Gathering dispersed parts into one object supplies the opening bodily analogue.
The same joining operation is applied immediately to the recitation unit.
Intrinsic straightness and completion sharpen bodily reconstruction into exact ordering.
Measuring and proportioning a created thing supplies the closing analogue of ordered formation.

structural_cues: The opening asks about gathering bones and restoring fingertips; 75:17 gathers the recitation; 75:38 closes with creation followed by proportioning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated gathering and exact formation across body and recitation; I supply the homology that both are acts of ordered reconstitution, while the live alternative is that bodily resurrection and revelation remain independent demonstrations of power.

changed_reading.before: Follow a transient stream of speech.
changed_reading.after: Follow a divinely reconstituted verbal whole, preserving its measured order as one would preserve the exact formation of an assembled body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of a patterned, directed course is activated by the surah's repeated endpoint toward the Lord, by faces directing perception there, and by the final driving. Following the recitation can therefore be carried as movement along an oriented course, not only reproduction of wording.

activation_trace.role: A manner, exemplar, and directed course anchors the recitation as a route.
Following a path or trace supplies movement along that route.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the route's governing endpoint.
The face as one's forward aspect supplies embodied orientation.
Directing sight or insight toward an object supplies conscious orientation to the endpoint.
Driving or conducting supplies inevitable movement toward the stated destination.

structural_cues: The phrase toward your Lord recurs at 75:12 and 75:30, while 75:23 directs faces toward their Lord between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus branch of directed course plus repeated orientation and final conveyance toward the Lord; I infer that the recitation traces that course, while the eschatological destination may be thematic context rather than a semantic extension of following here.

changed_reading.after: Enter and follow the recitation's directed course toward the Lord who governs its endpoint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a remote holding-for-verification branch rather than the ordinary recitation sense. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is sharpened by the explicit ban on hurried tongue movement; downstream prose should present it only as a process analogy for withholding response until reception is secure, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The first q-r-hamza act precedes the t-b-ayn imperative, allowing a held interval before the recipient catches up.

activation_trace.role: Holding for verification supplies a protected interval before the response is released.
Catching up places the recipient's movement after the held interval.
Hurrying identifies the pressure that the interval resists.

changed_reading.before: Repeat as quickly as possible to retain the recitation.
changed_reading.after: Hold the response until the delivered form is secure, then catch up to it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain gestational activation and is not a lexical claim that recitation means pregnancy. It remains valid as an exploratory model because the focus inventory itself contains a womb-enclosing branch and the surah closes with an ordered embryological formation; downstream prose should label it an analogy for protected assembly and staged emergence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The q-r-hamza root in the focus has a womb-enclosing branch, and the following imperative can track successive stages after that enclosure.

activation_trace.role: A womb enclosing a pregnancy supplies protected gathering before emergence.
Ordered succession lets the recipient follow the formed delivery stage by stage.
A seminal drop supplies the small initial material of formation.
Seed from which form is measured supplies generative potential within the enclosure.
Pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies attachment and retention as a distinct stage.
Bringing a created form into being supplies emergence from the gathered potential.

changed_reading.before: A completed utterance followed by imitation.
changed_reading.after: A protected verbal formation is gathered to completion and then followed through its staged emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the prayer root's racing image of the second runner rather than its ordinary worship sense. The image remains anchored in the focus catching-up branch and the later failure to pray; downstream prose should use it as a positional analogy for following the divine lead, never as a translation of prayer as racing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus t-b-ayn imperative can mean catching up with one who has gone ahead, placing the addressee in second position behind the recitation.

activation_trace.role: The divine recitation supplies the leading movement.
Catching up with one ahead places the recipient behind the lead.
The second runner following the leader supplies a concrete image of the worshipper's follower position.

changed_reading.before: Following is accurate vocal imitation, while later prayer is unrelated conduct.
changed_reading.after: The recipient takes the position behind the divine lead, and prayer becomes a later embodied instance of that follower stance.

strongest_changes: The adjacent gathering promise turns the recitation from a speech stream into a divinely assembled order that must be tracked rather than reconstructed by the recipient.
The ban on tongue movement and haste makes following deliberately posterior: reception first, response second, explanation still assigned to the divine side.
The later confirmation-worship versus denial-turning contrast expands following from vocal fidelity into enacted assent.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repeats one root around a single following imperative, and the whole-surah packet exposes several nested sequences: gathering then tracking, stopping haste then catching up, receiving then explanation, and hearing then embodied response. The wider bodily assembly and destination motifs also sustain qualified material and spatial readings without displacing the ordinary recitation sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The collecting sense of q-r-hamza is strongly activated by 75:17 but may remain an image beneath, rather than an alternative to, ordinary recitation.
The extent to which following includes obedience and worship beyond vocal reproduction is inferred from later contrasts rather than stated inside 75:18.
The held-verification, gestational, racing, and directed-course models are branch-grounded analogies whose intentional status remains uncertain.
